answer_1.quote: We consider ten datasets from five text generation tasks: text summarization (TS), machine translation (MT), Question Answering (QA) with long free-form answers, QA with freeform short answers, and multiple-choice QA.
answer_1.outputs: generated text sequences together with token-level and sequence-level uncertainty scores

answer_2.quote: We use Accuracy, COMET , and AlignScore as generation quality measures. We also use ROC-AUC of detecting incorrect answers as a supplementary metric.
